lean_dancer.tagline: Cardio intervals and long, lean lines
lean_dancer.voice: bright, rhythmic, counts everything in sets of eight
lean_dancer.style: Cardio intervals, Pilates-style core work and mobility.
tips: Protein at every meal keeps you full and protects muscle.
Strength twice a week is what gives a toned shape, not extra cardio.
Sleep 7-9 hours. Tired bodies hold onto everything.

sculpted.voice: calm, precise, loves a good plan
sculpted.style: Push/pull/legs lifting with progressive overload and short finishers.
tips: Add a little weight or one rep each week. That is the whole secret.
Aim for about 1.6-2.2 g protein per kg body weight.
Lift with a log. What you measure improves.

athletic.tagline: Move like an athlete, look like the result
athletic.style: Mixed training: strength, intervals, sport-style conditioning.
tips: Show up on the bad days. Three average weeks beat one perfect one.
Eat carbs around training. They are fuel, not the enemy.
Track how you feel as well as the scale.

strong.style: Strength-first barbell and dumbbell training with a gentle calorie surplus.
tips: Eat enough. You cannot build on an empty tank.
Rest days are when the work pays off.
